summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across Level 0, a social mall, The Hub and authored lore destinations; durable player.state carries progression, gear, quests, homes, companions, reputation and resume location. Shared player behaviors join generated and authored spaces; The Hub maps doors to destinations, while faction standing shapes dialogue, disguise and trade.
places: places/main (3D) - Level 0 yellow maze, ecology, routes, landmarks, anomalies and deterministic modeled dressing; seeded cubicles/camps and Blackout Zone edge lamp states.
places/bonus (3D) - vaporwave mall with simulated staff, shops, arcade, payphones, player-home kiosk, Squeeze Play and Glow Up Salon.
places/thehub (3D) - generated tunnel crossroads with destination doors, keyed thresholds, survey plaques, fixtures, camps, crew and quest props; Phoebe's first-arrival scene starts here.
places/intake + places/tutorial0 (3D; tutorial0 solo, ephemeral) - character creation/waking, staged tutorial and HALOGEN handoff to Dina's lead.

places/level01, level02, level1, level2, level3, level4, level5, level6, level7, level10-13, level21, level26-27, level31, level70, gamma, spamton, testlab (3D) - authored lore destinations; Level 1 has station/car-park-service geometry and the B.N.T.G. Trader's Keep in its far north-west Gild Sector; Level 31 is the Roller Rink and Level 70 Froidetown.
places/level5 (3D) - Homely Hotel / Terror Hotel; sim restores hotel systems and versioned Gentleman office, errand props and seated NPC.
places/thehub and places/level31, places/level70 - The Hub is its own crossroads place; Level 31 and Level 70 use Awakening lighting.
places/bonus/cells and places/main/cells - mall and Level 0 authored placements; Level 0 sim supplies generated maze dressing.
roots: world.config.yaml + templates/player.js - multiplayer entry, camera/player setup, ordered behaviors and input mappings; player template includes per-player Duller spawning.
places/<place>/config.yaml + cells/*.scene + sim.js - local configuration, authored placements and generated/ticked simulation; Level 1 dispatches geometry builders.
sim.js - global tick for body-style propagation and bounded incremental restyling in occupied places.

scripts/main-menu.js + main-menu-ui.js + intake/tutorial scripts - title, character creation, arrival, tutorial and Dina routing; main-menu update ticks errands, cutscenes, solo pause and faction hit squads.
scripts/player.js + scripts/camera.js + scripts/view3.js - player actions/state, wake/resume, aiming, third-person view and HUD zone naming; host camera yields to Absolute Cinema shots and cutscenes.

scripts/ui.js + scripts/stats-ui.js - composed HUD/menus and character status, quest journal, ledger, reputation, Level 70 CHILL bar and Absolute Cinema panel/overlays; cutscene-ui handles letterboxing and scene text.
places/main/sim.js + scripts/lib/maze.js + scripts/lib/xmas-room.js + scripts/lib/level0-moments.js - Level 0 layout and deterministic dressing.
places/thehub/sim.js + scripts/lib/thehub.js + hub-people.js + hub-dress.js + scripts/thehub-geo.js - versioned Hub topology, shell, doors, modeled dressing, people and key resonance.
shared: scripts/lib/hub.js + preload data/scripts - existing Bonus shared-room routing, solo room IDs, home destinations, display names and proximity preload (distinct from The Hub place).

scripts/lib/thehub.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js - canonical Hub tunnel/door/key registry, position helpers, one-use key inventory and door lookup; reused by Hub geometry, simulation, doors, quests and UI markers.
scripts/lib/loot.js + items.js + weapons.js/data/weapons.yml - common loot, containers, item definitions, rarity and weapon variants.
scripts/door-geo.js + scripts/lib/door-swing.js + scripts/lib/level3-hatch.js - parametric doors/motion and deterministic Level 3 paired hatch layout.
scripts/lib/data/l02-props.yml + l02-remodel.yml + l02-grid.js; breakables.js + breakables data + wallgrid.js - Level 0.2 remodel and shared prop/generated-wall damage and regrowth.
scripts/lib/quest-route.js + quest-mark.js + quests.js + errands.js - directed crossings and common quest/errand journal, tracker, rewards and step messaging.
scripts/lib/data/dlg-*.yml + dialogue.js + talk.js + voices.js + quest-dialogue.js - authored conversations, barks, voice selection and job-offer text; dlg-thehub.yml adds Hub cast dialogue.

scripts/lib/rep.js + scripts/lib/forgive.js + scripts/lib/data/clothes.yml + cat-wardrobe.yml - faction standing, disguise uniforms and role-based modeled clothing; talk, NPC reactions, shops and hit squads consume standing, while critter-model.js applies wardrobe looks.
notableExports: scripts/lib/save.js - SAVE_V, canSaveHere, wakePlace, migrate, wakeLog.
scripts/lib/critter-model.js - STYLE_V (sw196), sw194, furrySpec, restyle, restyleQueue, restyleStep, restylePlace.
scripts/lib/level31.js + level31-parts.js - venue geometry, zones, arrivals, labels, skating and layParts dispatch exports.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js - QID/QNAME, openCrate, useDeck, l31Choices, handleDialogueQuest31.
scripts/lib/level70-quest.js + scripts/terrain70.js - Level 70 quest, terrain and civic/life layer exports.
scripts/lib/errands.js - ERRANDS, held, errandText, offerErrand, payErrand, tryAlt, errandTick.
scripts/lib/rep.js - GROUPS, RIVALS, UNIFORMS, fameOf/infamyOf, groupOf, standing, addRep/addKarma, repKill/repKind/repTrade, isHated/isVilified, megRank, BNTG_RANKS/bntgRank, rankOf.

scripts/lib/hub-quest.js + scripts/lib/hubkeys.js + scripts/lib/hub-cut.js + scripts/lib/hub-route.js + scripts/lib/hit-squad.js - Hub quest choices/handler and route; keys; hub cut; squadTick/squadFollow.
ownership: scripts/player.js + scripts/lib/save.js - player.state progression, health/sanity, inventory/equipment, needs, combat, access, appearance, saved place/position, tapes, currency, karma/rep and homeKeep; save.js owns migration/versioning.
Transient appearance/pause state - scripts/critter.js owns per-player look and creator/wardrobe/salon state; scripts/main-menu.js owns session.tabAway and place.timeScale pause control.
scripts/lib/quests.js + scripts/lib/dina-quest.js - quests/qtrack/qdone/claimed; Dina trail keys, dinaQ stages, diary/cut/clue fields and migration.
scripts/lib/errands.js - player.state.errands records, errHints and errand journal entries; completion updates cents, payout, rep and hints.
scripts/lib/level31-quest.js + level70-quest.js + remodel-quest.js - Level 31/70 and remodel quest stages, routes and rewards.
scripts/build.js + places/level5/sim.js; scripts/l5-resident.js - homeKeep.built/l5built reconstruction, booking identity and place.state.l5rent.

scripts/lib/hubkeys.js + scripts/lib/hub-quest.js + scripts/hub-thing.js + scripts/lib/hub-cut.js + scripts/lib/hub-route.js - player.state.hubKeys and Hub quest/cutscene fields (hubMK/LR/UP, tapes, ledgerOpen/hubLedger, hubDinaAsk, hubRoute state).

scripts/lib/rep.js owns player.state.karma, fame[group], infamy[group], compatibility net rep[group], megRank and bntgRank; scripts/lib/hit-squad.js writes squadAt per faction and delayed squad state.
flows: world.config.yaml actions → templates/player.js ordered locomotion, player/foe, swim/climb, interaction, combat, inventory, social, hub, camera and quest behaviors; arcade-play.js and smoothie-player.js supply game-specific play.

world.config.yaml camera → scripts/camera.js; view3 writes player.state.tp/orbit → camera; camera writes aimPt/aimPitch → player ballistics/weaponAim; player zoneHere → maze and Level 31/70 labels (The Hub zones name Hub locations).
scripts/player.js wake → scripts/lib/save.js migration/log/wakePlace; valid savePlace crosses to saved place and savePos restores coordinates; periodic saves exclude intake, bonus and tutorial0.
scripts/routing.js requested room → scripts/lib/hub.js Bonus solo-room selection; toHub/toSolo cross to mall/home and maintain roomHop/save-place; this is separate from places/thehub.

Fresh visit → main-menu.js; START routes to intake or Bonus, wardrobe close runs intro-cut then tutorial0 first time or main later; ui.js visibilitychange/blur/focus → tabaway action → main-menu.js session.tabAway and place.timeScale pause control.

scripts/main-menu.js errandTick → scripts/lib/errands.js offers matching-place jobs; errands progress from carried items, kills and world events → quests.js journal, player.state.errands/qtrack and payouts; craft consumes pending item objects.

tutorial0 HALOGEN cut → tut0-cut.js + dina-quest.js; diaries/cuts/clues across Level 26, Level 1, Level 3 and Gamma advance player.state.dinaQ; dina-quest tick calls hub-route.js The Tenth Tunnel, unlocked at dinaQ 9 or hubPhoebe.

places/level1/sim.js lays l1-to-hub (state.to=thehub) and l1-hub-door/mark/light → scripts/level-door.js crossing → thehub; Hub arrival marker hub-from-l1 returns players to its arrival position. Level 1 zoneAt classifies KEEP bounds (-120<x<-80, -80<z<-40) as keep, and scripts/lib/maze.js maps l1_keep to its HUD name.

places/thehub/sim.js reads lib/thehub.js and hub-people.js/hub-dress.js → versioned shell, lamps, doors, props, crew and camp dressing; hub-door-geo.js renders doors, hub-door.js handles use/open/crossing, plaques label destinations and seals block unavailable destinations.

scripts/main-menu.js on thehub → lib/hub-cut.js hubCutTick at first arrival → Phoebe and player-specific cutscene camera/audio; skip/completion sets hubPhoebe/hubDinaLead, and HUB_LINES/VO time the voice-acted scene.

dlg-thehub.yml + npc-voices.yml → dialogue.js resolves Hub lines/voices; npc-starters.js adds hubChoices and talk.js dispatches responses to handleDialogueQuestHub; hub-thing.js ledger press sets hubLedger/hubLead/ledgerOpen → UI renders the ledger.

rep.js → talk/forgive/shops and Hub NPC choices: fame/infamy determine tiers, faction outfits disguise at distance (3 m close scrutiny); clothes.yml supplies B.N.T.G. apparel and fame-gated stock, while Level 1's Trader's Keep is a B.N.T.G. safe zone.
behaviorFamilies: places/bonus mall sims/shopper/salon scripts - authored mall shops/props and simulated staff; Block Panic and Squeeze Play are separate playable counters.

scripts/lib/data/furniture.yml + build-piece.js + build.js + home reconstruction - furniture-specific models/dimensions through common placement, persistence and rebuild; home11 and Level 5 use separate buckets.

scripts/door-geo.js + door-swing.js + prop-interactions.js + interactive-props data + prop-part.js - parametric doors/storage, legacy migration and tagged paired leaves; thresholds/sign boards share geometry.

Level 01 sim/Zenith geometry and hazards; Level 1 sim + level1-geo.js + level1-details-geo.js - authored station and car park/service geometry; corridor materials, pipes, fixtures and lights vary deterministically per corridor cell.

scripts/meg-agent.js + npc-temper.js + forgive.js + critter-model.js - shared NPC reactions, cover, voiced barks, movement/fighting and companion following; faction, role, outfit and first-hit assault handling vary by NPC.
errands.yml + errands.js + quest-dialogue.js + quests.js - shared job offers, objective stages, journal/tracker and rewards; named NPCs/levels vary objectives and text.

Level 0 kit builders/data + places/main/sim.js - model catalogs feed deterministic dressing in DR.batch rows with per-piece fixes and room-fit collision rules; l0-dress.yml varies cubicles/camp variants and blackout-edge lamp states.

places/thehub/sim.js + lib/thehub.js + hub-dress.js + hub-people.js - shared run topology and data-driven fixture/door models; position, branch gaps, door slots, seeded marks, camps, crew and props vary by run or site; destination plaques/seals share door registry.
probableOrphans: scripts/balloon26-geo.js - procedural balloon geometry exists, while Level 26 placements/barrage use uploaded models.
scripts/hairtest-rig.js - marked temporary hair lane rig; no current references found.
art/critter-hair-tripo/fit.py.held - saved fitter copy; active fit.py is the documented build fitter.
scripts/dbg-pose.js - debug-room mannequin gallery after places/debug removal; no current placement found.
scripts/dbg-bodypad.js, scripts/debug-pad.js - debug-room pads after places/debug removal; no current references found.
migrationNotes: Global sim.js runs every 250ms with a shared 40-eligible-object budget across live places; queues are machine-local snapshots, refilled when empty and discarded when a place has no players. It skips player roots and local-audience objects.

scripts/lib/save.js SAVE_V=2: intake, bonus and tutorial0 are transient and never save resume locations; migration clears legacy transient savePlace/savePos without overwriting earned state. player.js retries wake crossings up to three times.

The Hub's run frame and coordinates are centralized in scripts/lib/thehub.js; u follows a run, v spans its width, +X trunk, side tunnels alternate north/south. Preserve door IDs, OPEN/KEYED mappings and coordinates together across simulation, geometry and routing.

Hub place.state.hubV is generated-scene migration version (v8); its versioned rebuilds include door set, dressing, door-mark lamps and plaques. Hub Level Keys are player.state.hubKeys keyed by destination; keyed thresholds consume one matching key, three OPEN doors are permanent, and Level 178 deliberately has no destination.

Faction fame and infamy are separate durable 0..100 values per group; rep is their signed compatibility net for existing readers. M.E.G. and B.N.T.G. ranks derive from standing; hit squads use session state, not durable faction fields.

Level 1 Trader's Keep membership is the strict interior of scripts/lib/level1.js KEEP bounds x=-120..-80,z=-80..-40; zoneAt emits keep, safeZone includes it, and L1_NAMES/maze zone labels must retain l1_keep.
